data.one_liner: IMAP, POP3, and SMTP email library with high and low-level APIs and MIME parsing.
data.what_it_does: Provides high-level and low-level clients for IMAP, POP3, and SMTP email protocols along with MIME message parsing and generation capabilities. It includes email provider auto-discovery and character encoding support.
use_when: You need to connect an app to IMAP, POP3, or SMTP mail servers.
You need to parse or generate MIME email messages with attachments.
You want to auto-discover mail server settings based on an email address.
avoid_when: You are relying on a hosted backend like Firebase or Supabase for messaging.
You only need to open the device's default email client via mailto links without direct protocol handling.
strengths: Comprehensive protocol support including many IMAP extensions and security features.
High-level and low-level APIs give flexibility depending on control needs.
weaknesses: Requires manual handling of network connections and mail server states.
Complex email handling can require deep understanding of mail RFC standards.
